section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item instrument designed to measure positive body image. It details the scale's structure, scoring method (5-point scale, averaged for an overall score), and notes that item 12 is sex-specific, leading to two versions for women and men. The section also mentions the English version's psychometric properties, including its unidimensional structure for women, reliability, and validity, as established by Avalos et al. (2005). No specific studies are presented in this section.
